# Canonical

Canonical is a San Francisco–based early-stage venture capital firm that invests
in frontier infrastructure powering a post-AGI world.

It writes **$500K–$1.5M first checks** into deeply technical, often pre-product
founding teams building the "picks and shovels" of advanced AI and its supporting
systems: compute, data, agents, cryptographic coordination, robotics, silicon,
and the rails for how value moves.

> Not affiliated with Canonical Ltd (canonical.com), the UK company behind Ubuntu
> Linux. They share a name and nothing else.

## At a glance

| | |
|---|---|
| Founded | 2022 |
| Based | San Francisco, California |
| Managing Partner | Anand Iyer |
| Stage | Pre-seed and seed, frequently pre-product |
| First check | $500,000 – $1,500,000 |
| Website | https://canonical.cc |

## What Canonical invests in

Frontier infrastructure for a post-AGI world — the layers that have to exist for
advanced AI to be useful, affordable and trustworthy:

- **Compute** — silicon, data centers, and the economics of training and serving
- **Data** — pipelines, provenance, and rights
- **Agents** — coordination, memory, tool use, and the protocols between them
- **Cryptographic coordination** — verifiable computation and decentralized trust
- **Robotics and physical AI** — embodiment, actuation, and the supply chain
- **Value rails** — how money and ownership move in an agent-mediated economy
